narrative: The three sheets on the board, as on Wednesday night. No new line. The prison is not begun. The coffer is shut across the room and is not opened. On the board. The glass, still the last thing written. The margin is unchanged. On the board. The sheets stay in the light. Nothing is folded into the coffer.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the three sheets and left them on the board.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Three sheets, still on the board
